Around 17% of original Amazon has been cleared.

walkthroughs.body_html:
The Amazon spans ~5.5 million km2 across nine countries.

About 60% sits in Brazil, with parts in Peru, Colombia and others.

Roughly 17% of original forest has been lost.

Rondonia is a clearance hotspot.

The BR-364 highway opened the state; settlers cleared land in a fishbone pattern along side roads.

Result: lost habitat, soil erosion and rising emissions.

Sustainable management mixes several tools.

Selective logging and agroforestry keep tree cover; ecotourism brings income.

Internationally, REDD+ pays countries to keep forest standing.
